name: techbrief-workspace
description: Open-source multilingual tech news and indie developer digest product.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @techbrief/shared && npm run build -w @techbrief/feed-rules && npm run build -w @techbrief/ingest && npm run build -w @techbrief/runtime && npm run build -w @techbrief/converter && npm run build -w @techbrief/ai && npm run build -w @techbrief/pipeline && npm run build -w @techbrief/feed && npm run build -w @techbrief/scheduler && npm run build -w techbrief && npm run build -w @techbrief/server && npm run build -w @techbrief/web
scripts.pack:cli: npm run build -w techbrief && npm_config_cache=/tmp/techbrief-npm-cache npm pack -w techbrief --pack-destination /tmp/techbrief-pack
scripts.pack:cli:dry: npm run build -w techbrief && npm_config_cache=/tmp/techbrief-npm-cache npm pack --dry-run -w techbrief
